basic_info.description: The LM358 is a dual operational amplifier with a wide supply range of 3V to 36V, low quiescent current of 300µA per channel, and unity-gain bandwidth of 1.2MHz. It features input offset voltage up to 3mV (max), common-mode input range including ground, and high ESD tolerance (2kV HBM). Suitable for cost-sensitive applications in power supplies, motor control, and industrial systems.

seo.meta_description_en: The LM358 is a dual operational amplifier with 3V to 36V supply range, 1.2MHz unity-gain bandwidth, and 300µA quiescent current. Ideal for power supplies, motor control, and industrial applications.
seo.meta_description_zh: LM358 是一款双运放，工作电压3V至36V，单位增益带宽1.2MHz，静态电流300µA。适用于电源、电机控制及工业应用。
